scenes.script_text: Atomic Habits by James Clear in two minutes.
scenes.visual_concept: Colossal centered upright book 'Atomic Habits' by James Clear; Kai and Maya in explosive power stance demonstrating the 1% exponential rule.

scenes.script_text: Most people believe that transforming your life requires massive action,
scenes.visual_concept: Kai furiously strapping himself to a giant roaring rocket booster labeled 'MASSIVE ACTION' blasting upward frantically with sweat flying.

scenes.script_text: radical willpower, and overnight miracles.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya watching in disbelief as a stickman attempts to bench press a colossal 10-ton granite boulder labeled 'WILLPOWER', getting pinned underneath.

scenes.script_text: In reality, massive change does not come from giant leaps.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman attempting to leap across a bottomless canyon in one giant jump, comically frozen in mid-air looking down in horror.

scenes.script_text: It comes from tiny invisible daily choices.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai kneeling gently on white ground, planting a tiny glowing golden acorn seed with a confident, hopeful smile.

scenes.script_text: Here is the brutal truth.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya stepping forward dramatically, crossing her arms with an intense, analytical comic gaze breaking the 4th wall.

scenes.script_text: Winners and losers have the exact same goals.
scenes.visual_concept: Two identical stick runners at a track starting line staring at the exact same golden trophy, but one is smiling calmly and the other is trembling.

scenes.script_text: Every Olympian wants the gold medal.
scenes.visual_concept: A crowded podium where 10 stick runners all dream of the exact same shiny gold medal floating in thought bubbles.

scenes.script_text: Every job seeker wants the promotion.
scenes.visual_concept: A corporate ladder where 5 stick figures are all reaching for a single glowing briefcase labeled 'PROMOTION'.

scenes.script_text: The goal cannot be what separates them.
scenes.visual_concept: A giant golden scoreboard showing 'GOAL: WIN' shattering into pieces with question marks floating in the air.

scenes.script_text: You do not rise to the level of your goals.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman standing on an unstable, collapsing pedestal made of cardboard boxes labeled 'BIG DREAMS' crumbling beneath him.

scenes.script_text: You fall to the level of your systems.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai standing firmly on a massive, immovable solid steel foundation labeled 'DAILY SYSTEMS' that remains perfectly stable.

scenes.script_text: Goals are about the results you want.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman staring through binoculars at a distant, unreachable mountain peak labeled 'OUTCOME'.

scenes.script_text: Systems are about the daily processes that lead to those results.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai and Maya walking together along a clean conveyor belt of daily habits: running shoes, open notebook, water bottle, and checklist.

scenes.script_text: If you fix your systems, the score takes care of itself.
scenes.visual_concept: A giant digital sports scoreboard automatically ticking up points into the thousands while Kai calmly sips tea with feet up.

scenes.script_text: To master your habits, you must master the four laws of behavior.
scenes.visual_concept: A colossal ancient stone tablet engraved with 'THE 4 LAWS OF BEHAVIOR' glowing with golden light as Kai points forward.

scenes.script_text: First, make it obvious.
scenes.visual_concept: A giant glowing cartoon lightbulb flashing brilliantly above Kai's head with radiating comic rays.

scenes.script_text: Most people think they lack motivation when they really lack clarity.
scenes.visual_concept: A confused stickman wandering blindly in a dense grey fog bank holding a compass spinning uncontrollably.

scenes.script_text: Design your environment so the visual cues for good habits are glaringly obvious,
scenes.visual_concept: Maya placing a bright yellow book directly in the center of a pillow on an unmade bed so it cannot be missed.

scenes.script_text: and hide the triggers for bad ones.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai placing a glowing television remote and smartphone inside a heavy iron chest, locking it with a giant padlock and throwing it into a closet.

scenes.script_text: Second, make it attractive.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman's eyes turning into giant cartoon hearts as a delicious glowing slice of pie floats on a pedestal.

scenes.script_text: Dopamine drives our cravings.
scenes.visual_concept: A glowing electric dopamine molecule symbol pulsing with bright purple energy connecting to a smiling stickman's brain.

scenes.script_text: Bundle what you need to do with what you want to do.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai riding a stationary exercise bike while comfortably watching his favorite Netflix show on an iPad mounted to the handlebars.

scenes.script_text: Third, make it easy.
scenes.visual_concept: A smooth, frictionless polished slide where a stickman effortlessly glides from start to finish with zero effort.

scenes.script_text: The enemy of execution is friction.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman trying to sprint forward while dragging five heavy cast-iron balls chained to his ankles labeled 'TOO HARD'.

scenes.script_text: Use the two minute rule.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya holding up a giant, glowing comic stopwatch showing exactly '2:00' minutes ticking down.

scenes.script_text: When you start a new habit, it should take less than two minutes to do.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai tying the laces on his running shoes in 30 seconds and giving a cheerful thumbs up beside an open front door.

scenes.script_text: Run just one block.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman jogging casually past a single street corner sign labeled 'BLOCK 1' with an easy smile, no sweat.

scenes.script_text: Read just one page.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman comfortably tucked into a cozy armchair reading exactly one page of a book with an open lamp.

scenes.script_text: Master the art of showing up before you worry about optimizing.
scenes.visual_concept: A calendar where every single day has a bright green checkmark stamp on it, showing unbroken daily attendance.

scenes.script_text: And fourth, make it satisfying.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman biting into a sweet crisp red apple while golden victory confetti bursts around him.

scenes.script_text: What is immediately rewarded is repeated.
scenes.visual_concept: A smiling puppy stick figure doing a backflip and immediately receiving a glowing golden bone treat.

scenes.script_text: What is immediately punished is avoided.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman touching an electric fence wire with a loud 'ZAP!' and jumping backward in comedic shock.

scenes.script_text: Track your streak.
scenes.visual_concept: Maya holding a giant wooden quill pen marking day 100 on an unbroken wall of golden checkmarks.

scenes.script_text: Celebrate tiny wins.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai pumping his fist in the air with celebratory comic fireworks and streamers shooting off.

scenes.script_text: And remember the golden rule, never miss twice.
scenes.visual_concept: A calendar showing Day 1 checked, Day 2 marked with a red X, and Day 3 aggressively stamped with a giant DOUBLE golden checkmark!

scenes.script_text: Ultimately, true behavior change is identity change.
scenes.visual_concept: A stickman looking into a full-length mirror and seeing the heroic reflection of an Olympic athlete staring back.

scenes.script_text: Every action you take is a vote for the type of person you wish to become.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai dropping a glowing golden ballot slip marked 'DISCIPLINE' into a clear glass ballot box labeled 'FUTURE SELF'.

scenes.script_text: 1% better each day compounds into 37 times better in a single year.
scenes.visual_concept: A colossal exponential hockey-stick compounding graph soaring into the sky with a giant golden badge reading '37.78x'.

scenes.script_text: Small habits don't add up.
scenes.visual_concept: A simple plus sign '+' turning into dust and blowing away on the white floor.

scenes.script_text: They multiply.
scenes.visual_concept: A massive glowing multiplication symbol 'x' erupting with golden sparks and duplicating stacks of books and trophies.

scenes.script_text: So tell me below.
scenes.visual_concept: Kai and Maya standing together pointing directly down at the viewer / comment section with an intense call to action.

scenes.script_text: Would you rather achieve your ultimate dream goal today, but possess zero systems and slide back to square one within a year,
scenes.visual_concept: A lottery winner stickman showered in paper cash for one second, followed by him sitting broke in an empty cardboard box with zero habits.

scenes.script_text: Or master unbreakable daily systems where you improve just 1% every day, but own lifelong momentum?
scenes.visual_concept: Single cohesive horizontal split screen with central circular (VS) badge: Top panel shows bankrupt lottery winner / Bottom panel shows disciplined stickman thriving in total momentum.
